about_short_description.short_description: Democrance is a SaaS insurance technology platform.

product.name: Democrance Insurance Distribution Platform
product.description: A SaaS platform that digitizes the insurance sales and distribution process for insurers and brokers, supporting multiple insurance lines and products.

product.name: Product & Journey Builder
product.description: A tool within the platform to create and manage insurance products and customer journeys across all channels and segments.

product.name: Underwriting & Rating Engine
product.description: An automated engine that applies underwriting rules and rating models to increase straight-through processing and reduce manual referrals.

product.name: API Economy Integration
product.description: APIs that enable embedding insurance products into third-party ecosystems like super apps, aggregators, and mobile wallets.

product.name: Data Integration and Analytics
product.description: Integration with external data sources and authorities to optimize underwriting and gain portfolio insights.
